name: Duty Calls raises Physical weapon damage as well as Holy spell damage
contract: Duty Calls 705286 says "increases your damage dealt and movement speed by $560834s1%" (2% per stack of 560834, 5 stacks). Its buff 560834 carried aura 79 on the magic schools only (EffectMiscValue 126); the owner ruled that everything is included, Physical too (ADR 0287). At 5 stacks the Templar's main-hand weapon damage, which white swings and weapon abilities such as Righteous Lunge 570233 use, reads x1.10, and the Holy control Scourgebane 801832 reads x1.10 as before. Absolute reads at level 60 with item 2495 (authoring run 20261112-075907): minimum main-hand damage 62.455 without and 68.701 with the buff, Scourgebane 800 and 880 of a 1000 base.
